description: This Java source file defines the class 'HonoExampleApplicationBase', which provides a base implementation for consuming telemetry and event data from devices connected via the Eclipse Hono platform, and sending commands to these devices. It includes setup for messaging consumers, command clients, handling device notifications, and message processing logic.

classes.name: HonoExampleApplicationBase
classes.description: A base class that initializes Hono clients, manages message consumption from telemetry and events, handles device notifications for connection status, and sends commands to devices based on notifications.

methods.name: HonoExampleApplicationBase
methods.description: Constructor that sets up connection properties and initializes the ApplicationClientFactory.

methods.name: consumeData
methods.description: Method that initiates connection to Hono, creates consumers for telemetry and event messages, and waits for user input before shutting down.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates telemetry and event message consumers and sets up handlers for incoming messages and notifications.

methods.name: printMessage
methods.description: Logs message details including tenant, device ID, content, and payload.

methods.name: handleCommandReadinessNotification
methods.description: Processes device readiness notifications, either sending commands directly or handling permanent connection scenarios.

methods.name: handlePermanentlyConnectedCommandReadinessNotification
methods.description: Handles notifications for devices that stay connected, scheduling periodic commands if needed.

methods.name: createCommandClientAndSendCommand
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a command client for a device based on notifications and sends commands accordingly.

methods.name: calculateCommandTimeout
methods.description: Calculates timeout for command requests based on the notification's TTD value.

methods.name: setPeriodicCommandSenderTimerCanceler
methods.description: Stores a cancel callback for a periodic command sender timer.

methods.name: cancelPeriodicCommandSender
methods.description: Cancels the periodic command sender for a device if active.

methods.name: isPeriodicCommandSenderActiveForDevice
methods.description: Checks if a periodic command sender is active for a given device notification.

methods.name: sendCommandToAdapter
methods.description: Sends a command to a device via the command client, handling success and errors.

methods.name: sendOneWayCommandToAdapter
methods.description: Sends a one-way command to a device without expecting a response.

methods.name: closeCommandClient
methods.description: Closes the command client associated with a device notification.

methods.name: buildCommandProperties
methods.description: Creates a map of properties to accompany a command, such as appId.

methods.name: buildCommandPayload
methods.description: Builds a JSON payload for setting device brightness.

methods.name: buildOneWayCommandPayload
methods.description: Builds a JSON payload for a one-way lifecycle info command.

methods.name: handleTelemetryMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming telemetry messages, printing their details.

methods.name: handleEventMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming event messages, printing their details.
